formattedAddress: No. 34號, Youya Rd, Linquan Village, Beitou District, Taipei City, Taiwan 112

text.text:
Love the ambience, architecture n the cute landscape figurines! Omakase lunch was delicious especially the herbal duck soup.
Consider upgrading the service staff uniform to be more aligned with the premium pricing n elegant atmosphere.
Can improve on the range of toiletries in the spa rooms eg hair conditioner, facial cleanser, etc. Will recommend to friends!

text.text:
For an afternoon tea set, you also get a free ticket for footbath.
The minimum price per person is 500 NTD. For 6 person, a two two-person Afternoon tea set are enough.
Afternoon tea set is very thoughtful and delicious 😋
The water for the footbath is quite hot, the sunset is gorgeous 😍

text.text:
Marshall Zen Garden is a historic site that now houses a tea house, a hot spring spa, and a restaurant. It's unique location provides an excellent sunset view over Taipei. It is quiet and serene and has a hot spring foot pool for those that don't need the full body submersion.

The dinner served are all health conscious without sacrificing taste. It is a hidden gem that anyone in the area should visit!

text.text: Quite an experience, the hot springs water is really hot and sulphuric. There are insects in the water but just small ants that don't bother much. Room is quite dated, looks like 1970s, but clean enough. Window panes were dirty, don't get good view of scenery. Halfway through our 90mins soak there was some noise from construction outside. Also heard some loud conversation from next door. We were the only ones at high tea, which was a mix of savoury and sweet pastries and fruits. Pretty good, enjoyed the food and the drinks. Not the most value for money, but was a good relaxing experience. Come here if you relish privacy and would like to spend some alone time with a romantic partner.

text.text: Workers at dinner site are too lazy and has no customer oriented service by not accepting us into lunch.  We arrived at the place around 1pm for lunch, but the service people won’t allow us to go for lunch instead of having us go for afternoon tea, which there’s not much to fill my hungry and the food is ordinary.  I just want to say workers are too lazy to work and serve.  All they care is to ensure they can finish job by 2:30pm, their break .  There ‘s no service attitude with customer oriented mindset! We are arriving right on time but was told However, I have to give credit to the owner who decorated this place which giving the place a vibe of relaxing and touch of female charm ! But, remind the owner to retrain your staff with manor of rejecting customers!
